title: docs(qa): 18.0 sweep anchor round 17 — the ledger's remaining checklist-text findings, the console pin's stale citations and 79 "showcase isolated" respellings
body:
Refs #24579
Clause-②: no

Round 17 of the 18.0 sweep's wave anchor (claim `6303585734`, PM loop round 32). It applies the ledger's remaining checklist-text findings: #24903's follow-through (PR #24967), round 16's carried findings (PR #24963's acceptance notes), PR #24982's pin findings after the console pin moved to objectui `cf153eb2e535`, round 14's widening candidates (PR #24857), and round 12's "showcase isolated" spellings (landing record `6287983829`).

Only checklist text changes. 85 items in 10 area files each take one `revision` bump and one `history` row, and each row names its source and finding. There is no product code, test, pin, changeset text or `RUNNER.md` change, and no new item.

- Base `e4d604efd3`. `origin/main` `4fe3af9d7e` is merged in `6c4b8526af`. Its five commits touch no `docs/qa/**` path and none of the sources these edits cite.
- Every item, pin and objectui spec named below was re-read at the base, or at the console pin for objectui, before it was written. objectui was read with `git show` from a full scratch clone (`--is-shallow-repository` false).
- A scripted span editor made every edit. It is round 16's editor, unchanged, and it never re-serialises a file. For each area file it re-parses the result and asserts four things:
  - A1: the new document equals the old one with the declared ops applied.
  - A2: every other item and top-level key is value-equal.
  - A3: each edited item's changed paths lie inside its declared fields (array edits by exact index), plus `revision` and the one new history row.
  - A4: the text outside the edited items is byte-identical.
- A whole-branch check against the base agrees: 85 items changed, each with revision +1 and exactly one appended row, and no other path changed.
- The new history rows carry the placeholder ref `#PENDING-24579R17`, because a row's `ref` names this PR and the PR had no number yet. The next commit on this branch swaps in this PR's number and changes nothing else. The gates are re-run on that head, and the report comment on #24579 records them.

## The "showcase isolated" respelling

**79 respelled, 0 left as the posture.** Every non-history hit of "showcase isolated" was read in its item, and each names the dogfood §0 own-port boot. None is the `isolated` tenancy posture. The clearest case is `access-security.activation-write-operator-gate` `steps[0]`, which read "boot showcase isolated; … PROVE the posture is `single`". The 80th hit is a history row (`access-security.sharing-rules-widen` `history[3]`), and it is left as history.

The spelling names the boot by what it is, in `RUNNER.md`'s own words for it: the trap table's counter for `shared-browser-tab` is "own port/DB (skill §0)". One hit already named the canonical boot line, and it now says "RUNNER's canonical checklist boot", `RUNNER.md`'s term for that invocation. The new spelling holds for every boot command the items use, `os serve` included (`records-forms.encrypted-field-behavior`).

## Items left alone, with reasons

- `integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle` (PR #24963 (d)): neither pin is added, because neither holds its clause's whole oracle at that clause's layer.
  - `admin-routes-auth-guard.test.ts` drives all 11 routes three times on one real `HonoHttpServer` mount: anonymous 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`, unentitled 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the capability, entitled success, and the service method never called on a refusal. But its `auth` service is a double (`createSessionAuthService`), and its grants come from an engine double (`createGrantsEngine`, "the RBAC tables `resolveAuthzContext` reads, as a minimal engine double"). `acceptance[1]` is an api clause on a booted server, so the pin holds its route-layer half only. The ref's sentence "Neither drives the capability floor … drive os dev for every api clause" stays true of the two pins it names.
  - `datasource-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` enumerates the registrar against a capturing mock `IHttpServer` and compares the result with `DATASOURCE_ROUTE_LEDGER`. That is `acceptance[8]`'s ledger half, which its `verify` already cites. The 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` half is never driven, so it holds no whole clause.
- `records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save` (PR #24857's `form-view-subforms` candidate): no widening. At `cf153eb2e535` (blob `9485f378abd7`) the spec drives the stock New Invoice dialog with ONE line. It records only `/api/v1/batch` requests, reads `batches[0]` and never counts them. It asserts the parent op, a `{$ref: 0}` child, the auto-filled description and unit price, and the computed amount in the payload, and it re-reads nothing. So it misses `acceptance[0]`'s "one batch, not N writes" and two lines, `acceptance[5]`'s stored-row read, and `acceptance[1]` and `[2]` entirely. The ref keeps `acceptance[4]`.
- `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board` `automated.ref`: confirmed, as the table says. The item's revision bump is its `steps[0]` respelling, and its history row records the confirmation.
- Not this round, as the dispatch says: a fresh-install item for #24827's order and the live generation-0 refusal; the liveness row of `auth.emailAndPassword.resetPasswordTokenExpiresIn`; the fixture gaps of #24838 and #24841.

2. "Fewer than five of the ~80 'isolated' hits are the posture." This holds: 0 of 79.

## Acceptance notes

- Some edits were located beyond the dispatch's field list, inside items it names:

They describe `buildApprovalDecisionActions` (`approve_request` / `reject_request` in `record_header`, ordered -100 / -99, behind a client-side `canDecide`). At `cf153eb2e535` the record page renders `sys_approval_request`'s declared actions through `DeclaredActionsBar` above the page body: `approval_approve`, `approval_reject` and the other levers at `record_section`, gated by the server's `viewer` block. The knownGap says so, and no step or clause was rewritten. Re-deriving them is the anchor's call. Carrier: #24579.
  - `records-forms.crud-roundtrip`: `automated` is removed under round 15's rule, the same reading the dispatch names for (b). `acceptance[6].evidence` names the planted-row evidence.
  - `cli.datasource-introspect-codegen`: `knownGaps[2]` and `acceptance[0].verify` said "the pins in `automated`", and now point at `knownGaps[3]`.
- `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board` `steps[3]` reads "confirm every switch reads On … 31 On / 1 Off". At `cf153eb2e535` the Activation cell reads "Not running here", with the switch still checked, for a flow the engine left unarmed (objectui#13159, `packagedFlows.ts` `activationReading`). On a default boot the engine reports a deployment-policy `unboundCause` for `showcase_scheduled_digest` and `showcase_task_due_reminder` (RUNNER.md, the scheduled-work entry). The switch reading still holds, but a count of the cell's "On" badges will not. Noted, not applied, because the dispatch scoped this item to its ref. Carrier: #24579.
- Outside this round's spelling, 65 other non-history texts contain "isolated". Of these, 41 are the posture, 2 are other senses ("owner-isolated", "the isolated env"), and 22 name the own-port boot or its DB in other words: "an isolated boot on a file DB", "discard the isolated DB", "a dogfood-§0 isolated boot". Those 22 sit in 17 items: `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor`, `automation.connector-dispatch-matrix`, `automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal`, `automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract`, `platform-core.boot-health`, `platform-core.seed-integrity`, `platform-core.interrupted-migration-boot-report`, `platform-core.manifest-install-contract`, `platform-core.activation-ledger-registration-home`, `platform-core.activation-ledger-row-contract`, `platform-core.marketplace-install-local-lifecycle`, `platform-core.runtime-config-boot-read`, `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep`, `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`, `records-forms.field-group-visible-when`, `records-forms.field-unique-enforcement` and `studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep`. The same reading risk applies. They are outside the claim's file surface, which names the "showcase isolated" spelling, so they are untouched. Carrier: #24579.
- The dispatch's `records-forms.record-page-roundtrip` is `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip`: no `records-forms` item has that id, and PR #24857's note names the `studio-authoring` one.
- The crud-roundtrip planting recipe and its expected answers (`droppedFields` naming `lead_score` with reason `readonly`, and the clone carrying no `lead_score`) are derived from source and were not replayed. The verify says so.
- The objectui specs were read, not run. Their verdicts at `cf153eb2e535` are NOT MEASURED.

## Gates

The derived list is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`. It is computed on the actual change set: 10 paths against merge base `4fe3af9d7`, at head `6c4b8526af`. It gives 13 commands. Each one ran at that head with its exit code captured before any pipe, and each exited 0:

`node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` · `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` · `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test` · `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` · `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` · `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` · `pnpm check:doc-authoring` · `pnpm check:driver-memory-census` · `pnpm check:gitlink-declared` · `pnpm check:nul-bytes` · `pnpm check:platform-checklist` · `pnpm check:refd-timer-probe` · `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal`

The first run of `check:doc-formula-expressions` refused with exit 3, a prerequisite: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were not built. Both were built under the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, held 101 s, waited 0 s), and the rerun exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads "13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

No per-PR CI job runs `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, so this local reading is its evidence:

|:--|:--|:--|
| items | 16 areas, 328 items (323 active, 1 planned) | 16 areas, 328 items (323 active, 1 planned) |

| symbol anchors | 975/985 against 433 cited sources, 10 on the named residual (#16898), 18 file floors held | 975/985 against 433 cited sources, 10 on the named residual (#16898), 18 file floors held |

The new texts add no symbol anchor and no line citation.

`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` exited 0 against `4fe3af9d7e`. No open PR touches `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`. All 14 open PRs' file lists were read over REST; the three with more than 100 files were read page by page, at 349, 367 and 206 files, each equal to its `changed_files`. So there was no second merge-tree to run.

There is no ablation, because no tested behaviour changed. `skip-changeset` was re-measured: `docs/qa/**` appears in none of the 73 non-private manifests' `files[]` (86 tracked `package.json` files), and the repo root is private.
